content.title: About
content.content: Coffee creamer is a liquid additive designed to enhance the flavor and texture of coffee. This fat‑free version contains no fat, making it suitable for low‑calorie diets. It is typically based on water, milk proteins, flavorings, and sweeteners.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Liquid creamers are widely used in cafés and restaurants for quick beverage preparation.
The fat‑free version reduces the calorie count of a cup of coffee by about 30–40 % compared with traditional cream.
Some brands fortify the product with vitamin D and calcium for added nutritional value.
Creamers can be flavored with vanilla, caramel, nutty notes, and other tastes.
It mixes easily even in cold drinks such as iced lattes.

items.title: Calorie reduction
items.content: The absence of fat lowers the overall calorie content, which is helpful for weight management.

items.title: Bone support
items.content: Added calcium and vitamin D contribute to stronger bones.

items.title: Sweet taste without sugar
items.content: Sweeteners provide sweetness without raising blood glucose levels.

items.title: Easy digestion
items.content: Lack of fat makes the product gentler on the stomach, especially for those with sensitive digestion.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Some creamers contain whey protein, which may trigger allergic reactions.

items.title: Artificial sweeteners
items.content: Excessive intake can cause gastrointestinal discomfort in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Certain variants may have higher salt levels, which should be considered by people with hypertension.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Add 10–30 ml of creamer to hot or cold coffee to taste. It can be used for lattes, cappuccinos, frappés, and dessert drinks. Multiple flavor variants can be combined if desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in the refrigerator at 1 °C–4 °C. After opening, consume within 7–10 days. Do not freeze. Discard if color, smell, or taste changes.
